summary: Added /goal_semgrep Telegram command wiring and tests. Updated GOAL_COMMAND_SPECS with goal_semgrep, added GOAL_SEMGREP_USAGE, and implemented command handler in registerTelegramGoalCommands following the goal_plan_autocheck flow: show current/default mode (step), validate off|step|goal, enforce resolveChannelConfigWrites, persist via loadConfig/writeConfigFile, update in-memory cfg.goal.semgrep, and send mode-specific confirmations. Added tests in src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts for showing current/default mode, setting a valid mode, and rejecting invalid input. Verification passed: pnpm vitest run src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts, pnpm build, pnpm lint.
